name: DashPay Desktop (dashwallet-desktop)
author: PastaPastaPasta
description: Early desktop Dash wallet for macOS, Windows and Linux built on dashpay/platform's platform-wallet: Core send and receive, DashPay usernames and contacts, Platform addresses, shielded funds and CoinJoin on one recovery phrase. Pre-release builds are published as GitHub releases; no security review has been done yet.
